data.text: ADR-010 assessment: repeated reference-worker repair exposed a library/adapter gap: strict phased success cannot accept an acknowledged settlement of a value returned after the shortened work deadline. User approved explicit, capability-gated late settlement under the original finalization deadline. Ordinary finalization remains strict; cancellation, missing values, application errors and poll/destruction panics cannot recover success. Application Action meaning and native lease/commit uncertainty remain application/native-owned. No second engine or exactly-once claim. Earlier nested Bulkhead provider-loss finding is rejected: run_inner has no post-return check and dispatch has no await after returned provider evidence. Add actual admitted submission transaction coverage and narrow consumer cancellation evidence. Proposed tests remain unexecuted. No code commits or pushes authorized by this implementation request.

Implemented additive PhasedJobHandler::settle_late with opaque LateJobFinalization and LateJobSettlement. Existing handlers default to strict decline. Eligibility requires returned Ok plus only DeadlineExceeded and no destruction panic; the original phase kernel drives settlement without wrapping away callback return/Drop evidence. A private recovered completion checks successful finalization and rechecks native deadline/exit after destruction. Reference worker delegates both paths to its exhaustive Action settlement. ADR-010 invalid-state review: scopes/proposals cannot be constructed publicly or independently awaited (compile-fail doctests); missing/error/cancelled/panicked work never gets the capability; settlement failure, panic, deadline, post-return destruction deadline/exit, and invocation destruction cannot recover. Application semantic truth and remote acknowledgement remain unprovable locally. Public signature inspection shows an additive defaulted trait method and two opaque types only; no removed/changed call shape or deprecated shim is required. Focused Linux Rust 1.98.1 diagnostics passed: 8 phased-handler tests, adapter doctests including 3 new compile-fail checks, and disposable PostgreSQL 18 state-boundary probe including late last-attempt Confirm/Deny, delayed non-dispatch, manual/stale settlement, lease loss, deferred COMMIT failure, and actual submit_admitted cancellation after acknowledged transaction with exact replay/capacity verification. The seam does not simulate wire-level COMMIT acknowledgement loss; docs state this. Full required validation and fresh review pending.
